descriptions.subject: Local filer conversation
descriptions.text: The names are retained as cross-references. The subjects are filed under their last words. Read each wrist label and the two low bay labels. Haul each body onto its matching bay, then let go and check the receiving index. The counterfoil releases the correction kit in the supply cabinet. Please move the subjects, not the labels.
